verdict.rationale: Dual-booting is a fair axis for an operating system, but nothing in the pack documents installing macOS alongside an existing OS in a dual-boot setup. The only nearby item is a bare "Run Windows on your Mac" heading (macos-docs-18), which does not say whether it means dual-boot or virtualization, and is about the reverse direction. That makes it an adjacent capability that earns no credit, and the switcher material covers only file migration.
